episodes.title: ‘This is an extraordinary distraction’ the King doesn’t need, says late Queen’s aide
episodes.description:
ANDREW Mountbatten-Windsor has launched legal action against the police over their raid on his royal homes and his arrest, amid a storm of publicity as the Epstein files dominated headlines.

From the newsroom, Rhiannon Jones looks into what will happen at a private hearing between the former Duke's legal team, Thames Valley Police and a judge, the outcome could 'have a massive impact in any ongoing investigation' into the former Duke's dealings with convicted paedophile Epstein. Andrew Mountbatten Windsor denies any wrong doing.

Read more: https://www.thesun.co.uk/video/40588120/andrew-taking-legal-action-against-cops-is-bullish-says-suns-royal-editor-whos-paying-the-bill/

Sam Homewood and Rhiannon Jones bring you exclusive access, deep dives, and the real scoops behind The Sun’s biggest headlines. The stories that matter, direct from the newsroom studio.
